notes.title: Live Stream during CZ & SK Games Week
notes.notes:
As part of the CZ & SK Games Week event, we'll be hosting a gameplay stream on Thursday the 14th of November, starting at 12:00 PM PST! Join us for an exclusive look. Whether you're already a fan or just curious to see what our game is all about, we'd love to see you there!

Mark your calendars and we'll see you on the stream!

notes.title: New Release Date 11/11/24
notes.notes: We are part of the Steam CZ & SK Direct Showcase 2024 and we have moved the release date to 11/11/2024 so you can play the game earlier.

notes.title: Playtest until 27 October 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Playtest Now Open![/h1]

We're excited to announce that you can now request access to the playtest for Universe Has No Favorites! This test includes the first two parts of the four-part adventure. Explore the game before anyone else and share your feedback with us.

The playtest will run until Sunday, October 27, 2024. Don't miss out on this chance to be part of our testing community!

Click "Request Access" to join the adventure.

notes.title: We have the final release date - November 29, 2024
notes.notes:
The game is finished and we already have a final release date! Set an alert for November 29 this year or put the game on your wishlist. We are currently releasing a demo for a few days to celebrate the completion of the game and we are also going to have a public Playtest. We'll keep you posted here, on our [url=https://www.dsisoftworks.com/]website[/url] and on our [url=https://discord.gg/bEs5vMEdu4]Discord[/url].

notes.title: 2nd Steam NextFest Livestream
notes.notes:
[h3]Enter the world of CYBERPUNK in an Interactive Visual science fiction Novel game![/h3]
Navigate a dangerous cyberpunk world on the edge of civilisation as an escaped prisoner with unknown brain implants in your head.
Simply click on the interactive link in the text and you can explore the environment, use and collect items and store them in your inventory. Dialogues are also an important part of the game, giving you important (and unimportant) information you need to complete the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831501/974fa1ecd957ad3f6b639241b6ba2e6cd428ac41.gif[/img]

[i]Written by legendary Czech science fiction authors: Jiří W. Procházka, the father of Czech cyberpunk, author of the Ken Wood novels, and Štěpán Kopřiva, author of the epic Asphalt, a novel in which a group of mercenaries turn hell on its head.[/i]

notes.title: The demo is now available!
notes.notes:
[b]How long is the playing time?[/b]
An experienced player can finish the demo in about 3 hours.

[b]What platforms can you play the demo on?[/b]
This moment only on PC and MAC. Steam Deck support is also coming.

[b]How long will the demo be available?[/b]
The demo will be removed from Steam two weeks after the summer Steam Next Fest.

[b]When will the complete game be ready?[/b]
The release date is set for the second half of 2024.
